# Replace the sign-in form

## For the owner

**Goal:** The new sign-in form replaces the old one, with the same fields and a clearer error message.

1. The new form shows the same two fields.
2. A wrong password shows one short message.
3. The old form is removed after one release.

> [!WARNING]
> **Heads-up**
>
> - People with a saved form entry see the new look at once.
> - The reset link moves below the button.

> [!TIP]
> **Decided by you**
>
> - The design stays close to the old one.

> [!NOTE]
> **Decided for you**
>
> - The error text does not say which field was wrong.
> - The button keeps its colour.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Open question**
>
> - Should the old form stay for one release or two?

> [!CAUTION]
> **Serious risk**
>
> - If the new form fails to load, nobody can sign in. A switch turns it off at once.

## Work

1. Build the form.
2. Add the switch.
